comparisons.comparison: Both Citi and Goldman Sachs disclose that their allowance for credit loss (ACL) or provision estimates are heavily dependent on forward-looking economic environment assumptions. Citi explicitly states its analysis reflects the 'forward view of the economic environment as of December 31, 2024.' Similarly, Goldman Sachs identifies 'changes in the economic environment' and 'forecasts of future economic conditions' as key risks that could cause actual credit losses to differ materially from expectations.

sentences.text: Citi believes its analysis of the ACL reflects the forward view of the economic environment as of December 31, 2024.

Statements about our expected provision for credit losses are subject to the risk that actual credit losses may differ and our expectations may change, possibly materially, from that currently anticipated due to, among other things, changes to the composition of our loan portfolio and changes in the economic environment in future periods and our forecasts of future economic conditions, as well as changes in our models, policies and other management judgments.
